neighbours.label: the piece after 'short'/'small' in closed compounds (short|wave, small|pox, short|cake, short|bread)
fire: During the war, families tuned in to shortwave broadcasts from London.
Vaccination ended the smallpox epidemics of the past.
The shortwave band is crowded at night.
Many villages lost half their people to smallpox.
Grandma's strawberry shortcake won first prize.
A tin of Scottish shortbread sat on the counter.
Amateur operators use shortwave antennas on their roofs.
The last natural case of smallpox occurred in Somalia.
quiet: During the war, families listened to radio broadcasts from London.
Vaccination ended the measles epidemics of the past.
The FM band is crowded at night.
Many villages lost half their people to cholera.
Grandma's strawberry pie won first prize.
A tin of Scottish toffee sat on the counter.
Amateur operators use tall antennas on their roofs.
The last natural case of polio occurred in Somalia.

notes: Probes: shortwave 0.96, smallpox 0.73, shortcake 0.36, shortbread 0.27; shortstop, shorthand, chickenpox, microwave ~0. A list more than a pattern.
